list.name: Haggin Oaks Driving Range

list.price_note: Prices above are for the front (Toptracer) bays. Back range is $2 less per bucket: 75 balls $15 · 100 $20 · 150 $25 (warm-up still $6). Confirmed by a local golfer. Frequent-user cards add 15–25%.

list.surface_note: Mats (per the course's operator)
list.price_note: Frequent-user cards add a 15–25% bonus.

list.surface_note: Real grass tees (per the range's listings and reviews)
list.price_note: Bucket prices aren't published online; call.

list.name: Ancil Hoffman range
list.surface_note: Mats (tight or soft lie); grass on weekends when conditions allow
list.price_note: Bucket prices aren't published online; call the pro shop.

list.surface_note: Grass teeing area (about 20 golfers) plus 16 mat stalls

list.surface_note: Natural grass tee
list.price_note: Balls per token aren't listed.

list.price_note: Token cards: 10 for $65 · 20 for $115 · 100 for $450.

list.surface_note: Mats (per golfer reviews)
list.price_note: Token cards: 10 for $65 · 20 for $115 · 100 for $450.

list.surface_note: Mats (hitting bays)

list.name: Indian Creek range
list.price_note: Prices and hours aren't published online; call the pro shop.

list.surface_note: Natural and artificial turf tees; on grass 300+ days a year

list.name: Mather range
list.surface_note: Mats and grass teeing areas, 25 stalls

list.surface_note: All-grass tee (per the course)
